description: This file contains the implementation of the LocalGrainDirectory class, which manages grain directory operations such as registration, lookup, and silo membership in an Orleans cluster. It also handles silo status changes, caching, and directory partitioning.

classes.name: LocalGrainDirectory
classes.description: Implements grain directory management including registration, lookup, cache management, and silo membership handling.

classes.name: DirectoryMembership
classes.description: Encapsulates the list and cache of silo members in the cluster.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the directory services.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the directory services, prevents further requests from being processed.

methods.name: AddServer
methods.description: Adds a new silo to the membership list.

methods.name: RemoveServer
methods.description: Removes a silo from the membership list.

methods.name: CalculateGrainDirectoryPartition
methods.description: Determines the owning silo for a given grain.

methods.name: CheckIfShouldForward
methods.description: Checks whether a request should be forwarded to another silo based on ownership.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a grain activation with the directory.

methods.name: UnregisterAsync
methods.description: Unregisters a grain activation from the directory.

methods.name: LookupAsync
methods.description: Performs a remote or local lookup of a grain activation.

methods.name: DeleteGrainAsync
methods.description: Removes all directory entries for a specified grain.
